definitions.explanation: Extra space, time, or resources beyond what is strictly necessary.
A calm, relaxed state of mind; not being rushed or stressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have any time to spare.

examples.japanese: {余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: 余裕を持つ = to have a margin, to be relaxed

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: If there's room in the budget, I'd like to buy one more.
He had a relaxed, composed demeanor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくても→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I'm busy, I try not to lose my peace of mind.
examples.notes: {心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう} = peace of mind, mental composure

notes:
{余裕|よゆう} covers two related ideas: having a surplus of something (time, money, space) and being in a calm, unhurried mental state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have margin/room
- {余裕|よゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no margin/room
- {余裕|よゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to allow margin, to take it easy
- {余裕|よゆう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: easily, with room to spare

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}: spare time
- ⟦{金銭的|きんせんてき}→金銭的：21897_kinsenteki⟧{余裕|よゆう}: financial margin
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}: peace of mind, emotional composure
- {余裕|よゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: composed demeanor

USAGE:
{余裕|よゆう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ often means 'easily' in casual speech: {余裕|よゆう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ (easily make it in time).
